chunks: ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who gave one hajj to five people, and he said:
"One of them performs hajj with it, and all of them are partners in the reward."
He said to him, "For whom is the hajj?" He said, "For the one who prayed in the heat and the cold."

key_terms.الْبَرْدِ: cold endured during the journey and rites
key_terms.الْحَجُّ: the act of hajj itself ascribed to the performer
key_terms.الْحَرِّ: heat endured during the journey and rites
key_terms.حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً: one hajj being assigned or funded
key_terms.صَلِيَ: was exposed intensely and endured hardship

ai.seo_question: If several people share in funding one hajj, who receives the hajj and who receives the reward?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if the cost of one hajj is given for five people, one of them may perform it while all share in the reward. The hajj itself, however, is attributed to the one who undertook the bodily act and endured its hardship.
